code:
import numpy as np
from statsmodels.tsa.arima.model import ARIMA

errors = []
for t in range(train_size, len(series) - 1):
    history = series.iloc[:t]
    fit = ARIMA(history, order=(1, 1, 1)).fit()
    pred = fit.forecast(steps=1).iloc[0]
    errors.append(series.iloc[t] - pred)

rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean(np.array(errors) ** 2))
caption: Each step refits using only data available at that point in time, simulating real use.
